title: FJ60 2f to 1HZ
ai_summary: A 1987 FJ60 conversion from the factory 2F gas engine to a 1HZ diesel paired with an H55F 5-speed, retaining stock 3.70 gears and axles. One participant reported 21+ mpg at 70-75 mph highway cruising while loaded, running 31-inch tires. Builders discussed 24V-to-12V electrical fixes, radiator/fan-shroud modification, and moving the exhaust from the driver to passenger side to fit the diesel engine.

complications.detail: 1HZ is 24V while FJ60 is 12V; options discussed included voltage converters or rewinding starter/alternator to 12V (~$75)
Radiator lower port did not align with 1HZ; builder cut/turned the port and fabricated a custom fan shroud
Exhaust exits passenger side on the 1HZ versus driver side on stock FJ60, requiring custom piping
